comparison: P0 CAR_1 versus CAR_2; P7 CAR_5 versus CAR_6; exclude cycling-marker-positive cells from pairwise comparisons only
expression: Per-nucleus log1p(corrected counts / total corrected counts * 10000); original integer counts normalized independently for sensitivity check
effect: Difference of mean log-normalized expression; not log2 fold change
detection: Fraction with at least one corrected or original integer count
library_checks: Within-library expression differences calculated when both groups have at least 20 retained nuclei; descriptive, not animal-level inference
sex_sensitivity: Original integer counts: female-marker-like if Xist >=1 and no detected Y markers; male-marker-like if Xist undetected and >=2 of Ddx3y/Kdm5d/Eif2s3y/Uty detected. Others unclassified/ambiguous. Inferred marker groups, not verified animal sex. Matched-marker-group contrasts require >=30 cells per cluster; library contrasts >=20 each.
limitations: Only two libraries per age; animal independence unverified. No significance tests. Cycling markers do not establish completed cell division.
